description: This PHP class defines the CopyActivityModel within the OrangeHRM project, specifically related to the Time plugin API. It manages the serialization of project activities for copying purposes, including duplicating activities from one project context to another.

classes.name: CopyActivityModel
classes.description: A model class used to serialize and provide data about copied project activities, including the source activities and duplicated activities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CopyActivityModel with project activities from the source project and duplicated activities.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model data into an array suitable for serialization, indicating whether each activity is unique or duplicated.
